title: P2: CoAP context creation race condition
description:
File: python/src/lichen/dashboard/app.py
Lines: 66-70

The _get_coap_ctx() function checks if _coap_ctx is None and creates a context. Two concurrent calls can both pass the None check, both create contexts, and one gets orphaned - a resource leak.

Fix: Use an asyncio.Lock to protect context creation:
  async with _coap_lock:
      if _coap_ctx is None:
          _coap_ctx = await Context.create_client_context()
